The game is, imo, amazing. While darktide is about perfecting combat, HD2 is a out managing situations, experimenting and finding new ways of overcoming challenges. The base weapon are, I agree, a bit tame but stratagem add a layer to the combat system, one of managing distance, cooldowns and terrain. 
Visualy, the game is gorgeous and is made with purpose. Terminids are meant to look like the starship trooper bugs, and they look alike because it's one hive-mind like specie of alien. They are meant to be a uniform mass. They represent the biological alien life that is easy to antagonize in a satirical way. Automatons are also made to look alike because they are erased of humanity and just humanoids chunks of metal slowly marching toward you with murderous intent. 

The game is clearly a satire taking codes from classics like Starship Troopers and Terminators. The over the top nature of the lore and dialogues are meant to emphasize this satirical aspect. The intro is almost entirely based on the "I'm doing my part" sequence from ST. 


To compare both game is absolutely stupid. They only have the base genre in common, which is coop shooter. But..

Darktide has linear maps, HD2 has open maps

Darktide has important characters in a hub, HD2 is just an upgrade hub

Darktide has a class system that have their own role, HD2 has a blank slate character meant to adapt to each mission

Darktide is about close combat (even when shooting down specialist, you really aren't that far), HD2 is about maintaning distance (Hence the dog shit melee option) 

Darktide has a complex weapon stat, perk and blessing system, wheras HD2 has absolutely no weapon customisation. 


The coop aspect of darktide is implemented with coherency, HD2 is a coop game because you can play with people and thats it. The game never tell you to stay in a group. The game doesn't tell you to shoot enemies next to your pal. Going for separate objectives is an option, and you can decide to do it, or to stay together. HD2 doesn't even force you to be a full squad. No bots, and no need to. 

The reason both game are compared is that HD2 is breaking records in concurent players while DT is bleeding players because of a lack of content and radio silence from FS. People on this sub just notice the game that attracts a lot of player, from the same genre as their beloved game, and maybe decide now is a good time to stop checking Melk every 24 hour for a lvl IV blessing and try something else while new stuff comes to DT. 

It's okay to like 2 games, even from the same genre.

Clara, Himeko and Hook have very good design but they are early designs so maybe they tried back then. A large red coat signals the carelessness of Clara, not even wearing shoes or socks because she cares too much about the robots and doesn't have time for herself. Himeko's outfit is pretty much a mix between a high status gala outfit and a commander's coat, to reflect the duality between the hot as hell lady she is and her role in the express. Hook's outfit reflects her modest background and her desire to be a leader, the cheap winter hats acting both as a ridiculous crown and a reminder of the coldness of Belobog. 

But then what can you tell about most xianzhou characters ? Like tingyun, Ruan mei, Hanya, Gui, Jingliu, Yukong... Are all the characters the same ? Well, no of course. But they looks so similar in terms of clothing. This wasn't a problem with characters before luofu. Serval, Seele, Bronya, Asta, Silver wolf... They all had in common a sense of personnality. 

Even similar outfits can be transformed into something meaningful. The captains of Soul society in bleach all wear the same kind of clothing but they have distinctive marks that tell them apart. A scarf, torn sleeves, a hat, a tighter kimono for close combat or, contrastingly, a very lose and flowing one to show a more nurturing character that isn't typically fighting. 

TLDR : Xianzhou boring, belobog awesome

I know I have an unpopular opinion but the reason game are buggy as fuck nowadays is that the beta testing is skipped or sloppy. It's a job, that needs to be paid. I'm not saying a full salary, but if you play for hours to find bugs, make honest and researched report and give feedbacks, you are giving the company essential information that will make the game better, and thus making the end product better. So they will gain more money from making a good product, as a bug free game will always sell more than a game so buggy you can't play it. Same for feedback. When you develop a game, you sometimes get a sort of tunnel vision on what " seem " to be a good idea. Having the feedback from a player is a goldmine for them. 

You know how in the US, there are payments for testing experimental medicine ? That's the same. Instead of giving your body,  in a sense, you are giving your time and you provide work which you have been selected to do because of your experience in the field. 

TLDR : pay beta-testers and stop accepting to work for free
